_README: Template for nas_config.json (which is gitignored — copy this file to nas_config.json and fill it in). Powers the Storage tab's NAS section via read-only SNMP. On each QNAP: Control Panel -> Network & File Services -> SNMP -> Enable, choose SNMPv2c, set a READ-ONLY community string, Apply. Then put that string in 'community' below. For SNMPv3 instead, set snmp_version to 'v3' and add v3_user / v3_auth_key / v3_priv_key (auth+priv, SHA/AES recommended).
